cornerstone.notes: Quote verified verbatim on p368. Decisive wording: 'during the period commencing from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date and ending on (and inclusive of) the date falling six (6) months after the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”)'. This is an explicit inclusive END, not a duration wording: last restricted day = 2026-01-09 + 6m = 2026-07-09 and first free day = 2026-07-10. The candidate used the anniversary convention (2026-07-09/2026-07-08) - corrected per convention. Glencore AG's additional tiered restriction (max one third of subscribed Offer Shares per 30 months after the Lock-up Period ends) is verbatim in the same passage and correctly noted; it does not change the general first free day.

corrections.basis: restricted period commencing on (and inclusive of) the Listing Date (2026-01-09) and ending on (and inclusive of) the date falling six months after the Listing Date (2026-07-09); both endpoints expressly inclusive, so first free day is the day after the inclusive end

controller_6m.notes: Quote verified verbatim on p375. 'ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date' - explicit inclusive end: 2026-01-09 + 6m = 2026-07-09 last restricted, first free 2026-07-10. Matches candidate.
